refreshPolicy: Refresh on an AntD runtime upgrade.
Refresh when the CLI design-language or component dataset changes.
Refresh the complete official Blog snapshot when its reviewed commit changes.
Review the affected decision card when an official design pattern changes.
Add a frozen component reference before a new component enters a generated page.

offlineQueries.componentInfo: npm exec --offline -- antd info <Component> --version 6.5.0 --lang zh --format json
offlineQueries.componentDoc: npm exec --offline -- antd doc <Component> --version 6.5.0 --lang zh --format json
offlineQueries.componentDemo: npm exec --offline -- antd demo <Component> --version 6.5.0 --lang zh --format json

officialBlog.role: Complete first-class Blog source for component decisions, interaction details, visual regression, engineering risks, and version migration.

officialSources.role: Canonical v6 color, typography, spacing, radius, surface, shadow, motion, component-archetype, and theming language.
Exact-commit recursive snapshot of every official Blog source file, with a localized article index and page-level selection metadata.
Evaluation values for enterprise-product decisions: natural, certain, meaningful, and growing.
Information grouping and the 8/16/24 px hierarchy.
Shared visual starts, form alignment, and right-aligned comparable numbers.
Primary-secondary action hierarchy and neutral treatment for prudent decisions.
Separation of templates, base components, business modules, and general concepts.
Adaptive canvas, 24-column grid, gutters, and common page scales.
Typography scale, 14/22 base text, restrained weights, and readable contrast.
List-page goals, filter placement, table/list selection, drill-down, and batch operations.
Information complexity, grouping, tabs, cards, steps, and progressive disclosure.
Back-office composition patterns for layout, query tables, forms, descriptions, and page skeletons.
Query-form collapse and light-filter composition patterns.
ModalForm and DrawerForm lifecycle, controlled opening, submission, and reset patterns.
Structured-data behavior, column API, scrolling, fixed columns, pagination, and virtual-list constraints.
Field collection, validation, dependencies, layout, and submission behavior.
Focused decisions, async confirmation, context, width, and close behavior.
Context-preserving side tasks, size, nesting, mask, and teardown behavior.
